translation.title: Dexamethasone Propionate Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used to treat the eczema and dermatitis group (including progressive keratoderma of the fingers, lichen simplex chronicus and solar dermatitis), the prurigo group (including papular urticaria), insect bites, psoriasis, pustulosis of the palms and soles, lichen planus, erythroderma, chronic discoid erythema, drug eruption / toxicoderma, and alopecia areata.
translation.usage: Apply an appropriate amount to the affected area 2 to 3 times a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or if you have cutaneous tuberculosis, herpes simplex, chickenpox, herpes zoster, vaccinia rash, eczematous otitis externa with a perforated eardrum, ulcers (excluding Behcet's disease), second-degree deep or more severe burns or frostbite, or bacterial, fungal, spirochetal or viral skin infections. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, if you are breastfeeding, for children, or if you are elderly. Do not use this medicine in the eyes (not for ophthalmic use). Do not use it after applying base makeup or after shaving. Adverse reactions may occur - candidiasis, tinea (ringworm), impetigo contagiosa, folliculitis, viral infections, skin irritation and rash, and, when used on the eyelid skin, increased intraocular pressure, glaucoma (blurred vision) or blurred vision of unknown frequency; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Visual disturbance may occur due to systemic absorption. Store at room temperature away from light and keep out of reach of children.
